authorization: User requested autonomous measurement-gap and curriculum/Learning Commons research on October 12, 2026, with results by the following morning.

scope.measurement: Test whether original high ratings and independently audited concerns occur on the same saved tasks.
scope.grounding: Compare the latest generator without retrieval, with curriculum evidence, and with curriculum plus Learning Commons evidence.
excluded: human ratings fabricated by an assistant
changing historical rubric scores or generated tasks
optimizing generation against the new auditor

measurement_gap.sampling: Freeze a score-independent representative sample before new judgments; retain original ratings on precisely those tasks.
measurement_gap.judge_independence_boundary: Different OpenAI model series, not independent human experts or different model vendors.

high_rating_screen.interpretation: A predefined descriptive subset, not a validated educational-quality threshold.

finding_categories: agreed concern under an original rubric anchor
agreed concern under an additional PF design criterion
measurement_gap.controls: Freeze positive, negative and ambiguous controls. Assess errors rather than adjusting expectations to obtain a perfect calibration.

arms.external_evidence: No retrieved curriculum or Learning Commons evidence.
Frozen curriculum/textbook excerpts; curated expert-resource lists held out.
The same curriculum excerpts plus frozen Learning Commons descriptions, explicitly not additional assumed learner knowledge.

grounding.calibration: One or two distinct specifications; single generation per arm; execution checks only.
grounding.retrieval: Retrieve and freeze per specification before main generation; keep source, licensing, excerpts, query, selection and hashes.
grounding.topic_status: Choose distinct task specifications and report whether their broader topics were previously inspected; do not relabel transfer cases as untouched holdouts.
grounding.audit: Use the same frozen evidence-specific task audit for every arm, blinded to condition and retrieval payload, with the common authoritative learner context.

statistical_interpretation.primary_grounding_outcome: A prespecified conjunction of mathematics support, target preserved, accessible start, discovery preserved and consequential choice, reported with component findings and unknowns.
statistical_interpretation.routes: Distinct mathematical reasoning and representation opportunities reported separately from the primary conjunction.
statistical_interpretation.nested_sampling: Four outputs within each of five task specifications are repeated generations, not twenty independent curriculum or task-family observations.
report: condition component rates with explicit scheduled and judged denominators
statistical_interpretation.conclusion: Evidence for or against a benefit in this bounded pilot, not proof of general educational effectiveness.

stopping.control_misclassification: Record instrument limitations; do not retune to reject a favored or disfavored generation arm.
stopping.api_failures: Preserve explicit errors; no automatic replacement of failed experimental attempts.
stopping.unavailable_learning_commons: Do not substitute invented records or silently collapse arms. Preserve unavailable status and report the narrowed comparison.
stopping.unexpected_bug: Version a technical correction with its cause and affected calls; preserve previous artifacts.
